text:
ops-bot: [ALERT] Nightly perf dashboard: p95 inference latency +22% vs last 24h starting 03:10 UTC. Affected: models using kernel-selector v3.4 and large KV hotset shifts. Dashboard: https://dash.redwoodai/internal/nightdash/4976
arjun: seeing same in SRE traces, p99 tail also up ~10%. CI job runtime-perf-ci failed on main at 03:05 with perf regression (see job https://ci.redwoodai/runs/8123)
lee: any recent merges around kernel selector or batching heuristics? last deploy includes PR 5342 (adaptive-kernel-weighting) and PR 5390 (kv-hotset-prefetch)
maria: I can pull profiler from 03:00-04:00. attaching small flamegraph excerpt:
```text
kernel_select() -> 48%
batch_coalesce() -> 22%
kv_cache_lookup() -> 15%
other -> 15%
```
arjun: interesting that kernel_select dominates. Can someone run `git bisect` between 7b9a2c (last-green) and HEAD? suspect PR 5342
sahil: started bisect run: `ci-bisect --range 7b9a2c..HEAD --job runtime-perf-ci --metric p95` — first bad commit appears to be `c1f2d4a` (PR 5342 merge)
lee: confirmed locally: reverting the kernel-weighting change drops p95 back to baseline in our staging perf harness
maria: KV logs show spike in eviction rate at 03:07 coinciding with kernel weight flip — we may be misrouting requests to less optimal kernels causing more cold KV accesses
arjun: mitigation options: 1) temporary rollback of PR 5342 (fast) 2) force older kernel-selector policy via feature flag (safer) 3) canary rollback to 10% then measure
sahil: I'm going to apply feature-flag override to pin selector v3.3 for all nightdash clusters now
ops-bot: deploy started by sahil at 03:42 UTC — monitor: https://deploys.redwoodai/rollouts/894
lee: after flag pin, p95 back to normal in canary nodes (03:55). rolling to remaining nodes now
maria: follow-ups: add unit/regression tests in runtime-prober to simulate hotset shifts; add metric to nightdash for kernel selection hops per-request
arjun: filing a revert PR and postmortem. PR link: https://git.redwoodai/p/5401 (revert PR 5342). assign: @sahil to own rollback, @maria to own PV logs/profiler
lee: good catch everyone :thumbsup:
ci-bot: runtime-perf-ci: back to green (run 8127) after feature-flag pin
sahil: closing thread once rollback merged and postmortem linked
